title: How Can Canned Food Last for Years?
short_title: How Can Canned Food Last Years Without a Fridge?
description: A can of beans can sit on a shelf for years without a fridge. Here is the simple science: seal, cook hot to kill germs, and a vacuum. A bulging, leaking or badly dented can should be thrown away.
comment: What is the oldest can in your kitchen? Tell me below!

scenes.text: How can a can of beans sit on a shelf for years, with no fridge, and still be safe to eat?
Step one: the food goes into the can, and the lid is locked on with a double seam, so nothing can get in.
Step two: the sealed can is cooked really hot, often above one hundred degrees, in a giant pressure cooker. That kills the germs inside.
Step three: as the can cools, the steam inside turns back into water. That leaves almost no air, a tiny vacuum that pulls the lid down.
No living germs, no fresh air, no spoiling. That is why canned food can last for years.
But a bulging, leaking or badly dented can means trouble. Throw it away.
